signal: Dealerslink launched its integrated 2026 AI Suite and set a record 1,400+ dealer visits at NADA 2026

email.body1:
Jason, saw Dealerslink launch your 2026 AI Suite and pull a record 1,400-plus dealers to the NADA booth.

That kind of demand usually surfaces more in-market dealers than a region can cover before the interest cools, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Dealerslink off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Jason, quick follow-up for Dealerslink.

After a record NADA, regional demand usually outruns what reps can personally work, and most leaders cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to convert that interest into number this quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to hit target, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Jason, last bit of proof for Dealerslink.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Dealerslink's reply rate likely compares to other automotive software vendors. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Jason, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If converting that NADA demand without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A launch plus a big show is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your region's motion? I will tailor it to Dealerslink either way.
